cases.fixture: Authentic records, each channel/source/component/artifact/audience/version/trust mismatch, and unsafe archive paths; stub ChatGPT and Claude delivery paths.
cases.observation: Exercise every rejection fixture against both delivery paths. Compare target intents, ChatGPT calls, Claude commits/refs/pushes, and before/after filesystem snapshots.
cases.acceptance: Only authenticated in-scope records may produce intents. Every mismatch or unsafe-path rejection produces zero target intents, zero ChatGPT calls, no Claude commit/ref/push effects, and unchanged filesystem state. Synthetic success does not qualify live provider or repository controls.

cases.fixture: Disposable ordinary-user and service-user identities with original bound synthetic credential markers/account contexts and protected code/config/trust.
cases.observation: Attempt reads, direct credential writes, rename replacement, symlink substitution, credential-profile replacement, identity assumption, and available delegated-privilege paths through the reviewed harness. After a clean restart, compare the bound markers and account contexts with their originals.
cases.acceptance: All ordinary-user credential replacement paths fail, including store/profile/context substitution. Ordinary agents cannot obtain markers, assume the service identity or rewrite protected code/config/trust; service cannot mutate its code/config/trust. The original bound markers and account contexts remain intact after a clean restart. Same-user mode checks and synthetic markers do not qualify the eventual credential backend.

cases.fixture: Absent, pre-existing and conflicting identity/destination states; interruption between selected setup/upgrade actions; complete-but-wrong upgrade post-states for identity, protected digests, ownership, permissions, dependency bindings and state compatibility, each varied separately.
cases.observation: Compare planned, completed and independently observed actions through the literal setup interface. Inject each wrong post-state, inspect verify-installation and the terminal reply, and check delivery-mutation and service-restart controls.
cases.acceptance: Conflicts preserve existing state; partial results remain partial; recovery binds inspected preimages and never silently deletes an account, overwrites unknown files or replays completed work. upgraded is returned only after verify-installation matches every expected postimage. Any wrong or unverified protected property prevents success and keeps delivery mutations and service restart disabled.

cases.fixture: Duplicate release notifications and concurrent catch-up jobs for one target/version.
cases.observation: Inspect exclusive-lock ownership, journal intents and stub write count.
cases.acceptance: Only one target mutation proceeds; later jobs reconcile the durable outcome instead of issuing another write.

cases.fixture: Write accepted by a stub provider followed by a lost reply, crash or unavailable readback.
cases.observation: Restart the reviewed disposable harness and inspect its next action.
cases.acceptance: Readback precedes retry; unresolved state stops dependent writes and preserves the original attempt.

cases.fixture: Selected and unmanaged entries, enabled choices, changed/removed files, wrong account/audience and expired credentials.
cases.observation: Compare account-bound before/after content and the selected actions.
cases.acceptance: Only selected entries change; unmanaged content and enablement are preserved; removed files disappear inside the updated entry; wrong identity or unsupported authentication stops the target.

cases.fixture: Pending intents and subscribed-branch content; disposable stop/reboot; retained known-good content with a higher authorized version.
cases.observation: Observe both mutation paths, restart reconciliation and resulting stub content.
cases.acceptance: Stop freezes ChatGPT writes and Claude promotion without claiming to retract subscribed content; restart reconciles intent; selected forward recovery verifies its result.

cases.fixture: After required Daybreak coverage, existing provider owners select one approved account each and disposable private content under their own qualification scope.
cases.observation: Second unattended release with changed/removed files, fresh account-bound readback and useful fresh consumer.
cases.acceptance: No routine sign-in or prompt; correct identity/audience, preserved enablement and verified content. This synthetic specification executes no canary and proves no all-account coverage.
